continuous.release_gate: No cumulative fence delay. Retain individual increases and interpret using matched starts.

phase_investigation.conclusion: The two individual longer passes start at different video and memory phases. The raster saves clocks in both and each workload improves at both identical starting phases.

matched_dirty_skip_seed_scope: Both revisions upload the attachment independently produced by SRR for original A. The full RGB565 image is copied through ordinary heap packets and COPY_RECT, while an empty depth-DISCARD pass reproduces A's validity. A discards depth, so all external D24 remains at the boot value. The independent original-A oracle checks both full color buffers and all full D24 words before B. B uses an identical starting phase and timed packet stream. The matched test times B separately. The two unmodified natural A+B runs and their seed and B timings are retained above, since A itself can accelerate and move B's start.
